queries.latency: label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, hv_operation) (rate(hv_operation_duration_milliseconds_bucket{http_route!~"/api/operator/.*"}[5m]))), "quantile", "p50", "", "") or label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, hv_operation) (rate(hv_operation_duration_milliseconds_bucket{http_route!~"/api/operator/.*"}[5m]))), "quantile", "p95", "", "") or label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, hv_operation) (rate(hv_operation_duration_milliseconds_bucket{http_route!~"/api/operator/.*"}[5m]))), "quantile", "p99", "", "")

backendContract.note: Real Prometheus 3.14.0 and OpenTelemetry collector: the three new instant expressions parse and return series against the collector-translated metric names (hv_operation_duration_milliseconds_bucket, hv_operations_total), histogram_quantile yields per-operation latency rows, and the hv_failure_code label is present on error series. The bundle fails closed, so a green run means all four queries succeeded.
